🎬 CASTING-AUFRUF: Vater & Kind-Rolle für Kurzfilm „05:05“ 🎬
Für das experimentelle Kurzfilm-Drama „05:05“ (Regie & Produktion: Ewald Kiricenko / HdM Stuttgart) suchen wir die Besetzung für zwei wichtige Rollen.  

(Hinweis: Die Hauptrolle des 19-jährigen Eren ist bereits besetzt!)  

📌 Projekt-Details:

 Titel: 05:05  

 Format: Experimenteller Kurzfilm (Drama / Social Study)  

 Ausstrahlung: Filmfestivals, MUBI, YouTube  
 Regie & Produktion: Ewald Kiricenko  

 Kontakt / Bewerbung: ewald.kiricenko@gmail.com | Tel.: 0176 21462320  

📖 Logline:
Ein 19-Jähriger hat bis Mitternacht Zeit, sich für eine sichere Zukunft zu bewerben. Doch während sein Vater, Social Media und eine zunehmend vertraute KI ihm erklären, was aus ihm werden soll, muss er entscheiden, ob er sein Leben auf eine Zukunft ausrichten kann, an die er selbst nicht glaubt.  

🎭 Gesuchte Rollen:

1. ONUR / VATER (männlich)

 Spielalter: ca. 45–55 Jahre (Figur ist 47 Jahre alt)  
 Rollenprofil: Erens pragmatischer Vater. Er meint es grundsätzlich gut und sorgt sich ehrlich um die finanzielle Zukunft seines Sohnes („etwas Sicheres/Vernünftiges lernen“), versteht jedoch Erens Wunsch nach einer künstlerischen Laufbahn nicht.  

 Anforderungen: Starke Präsenz, Überzeugungskraft, authentisches Zusammenspiel in emotional geladenen Dialogszenen (Konflikt zwischen elterlicher Fürsorge, Pragmatismus und Unverständnis).  

2. KIND EREN (männlich)

 Spielalter: ca. 9–12 Jahre (Figur in der Rückblende ist ca. 11 Jahre alt)  

 Rollenprofil: Eren als Kind in Rückblenden / Erinnerungsszenen. Ein aufgeweckter, unbeschwerter Junge mit einer natürlichen Begeisterung für das Zeichnen.  

 Anforderungen: Authentisches, pures Kinderlächeln, Freude am Malen/Zeichnen. Kompakter Drehaufwand.  

📩 Bewerbung:

Bitte sendet eure Bewerbung mit dem Betreff „Casting 05:05 – [Rolle: Vater OR Kind Eren]“ an:
📧 ewald.kiricenko@gmail.com

Inhalt der Bewerbung:

 Für die Vater-Rolle: Aktuelle Fotos (Porträt & Ganzkörper), Wohnort, Kontaktdaten sowie Showreel / Arbeitsproben (falls vorhanden).

 Für die Kind-Rolle (durch Erziehungsberechtigte): Name & Alter des Kindes, 2–3 aktuelle Fotos, Wohnort & Kontaktdaten der Eltern.

📄 Weitere Infos zum Visuellen Stil und zur Stimmungs-Welt findet ihr im Pitchdeck hier: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YSoMOpidVeFM0DwhE_ZnwZwzE-Wa8usT/view?usp=drivesdk

Wir freuen uns sehr auf eure Einsendungen! 🎥✨

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas

I present my movies on International Film festivals and was lucky to receive some awards. 
But the work is not about awards and money, its about making movies for the people to think about.
My next movie is a modern love story:
An elderly man is meeting another younger, very attractive man in the Internet. But they are from different Continents. They start a long distance relastionship ship. which is full of passion and desire. 
One day the younger man starts to ask for money, cause he is a Student and no more able to pay his bills. 
The older man is full of distrust.
Is he only there to pay his lovers bills or is there love between them ?
A story with two endings.
One with true love and one with only cheating. Based on a real story.
I am looking for the young attraktive Lover.
Men 25 to 36 years old, good looking who is able to film his parts on his own by smartshone

Thats me

items.text:
SEEKING ACTORS FOR STUDENT FILM
Title: Sabotage

Genre: Action Drama

Director: Annabelle Clement

Producer: Leo Callanen

Production Type: Student Short Film

🎥🎬🎞️📽️

Logline: When talented up and coming boxer Jade Mercer’s title is challenged by a close friend, the two fighters find themselves navigating personal betrayal and doping scandals in a grisly battle for dominance in their local underground tournament. 

Synopsis: Sabotage follows a pair of underground fighters who find themselves facing each other in the ring for the first time, neither of whom are happy. Jade, the current reigning champion, fears the rift that may grow between herself and her friend should she win. Maya, the

underdog, fears the embarrassment of losing to a close friend. As the match between the two

approaches, Maya is offered a mysterious performance enhancing substance by the girls’ Coach Sean. With the introduction of these drugs, the dynamic in the ring flips on its head. Maya, taking Jade down in dramatic fashion, strips her friend of the title. This defeat sends an injured Jade on a quest to rebuild herself and her reputation in hopes of reclaiming her title. One year later, she faces Maya in a match that will decide much more than the winner of the tournament.

LEAD ROLES 🩸

Jade Mercer: Early 20’s. Jade is extremely talented in the ring, the shining star of the underground, and a fan favorite. Jade works hard and gets results, always raising the bar for herself. Despite her intensity in the ring, she’s quite caring outside of it. 

Maya Mitchell: Early 20’s. Maya may not possess the same natural talent as Jade, but she’s every bit her equal when it comes to drive and commitment. Frustrated with her skill level, she’s determined to progress in the sport by any means possible. 

Coach Sean: Late 30’s. Sean is a retired professional boxer and current coach to Maya and Jade. Gruff, hypermasculine, and corrupt; Sean frequents the betting tables at competitions. 

ADDITIONAL ROLES 🎤

Emcee: High-energy, dramatic boxing announcer. Open to adults of all genders.

Tournament Employees: Young, nervous, eager. Open to young adults of all genders.

Referee: Stoic, sharp, rule-enforcer that doesn’t mind looking the other way. Open to mature adults of all genders.

Judges Panel: Mysterious, judgemental, and corrupt. Open to mature adults of all genders.

Extras: 

We are also seeking adults of all genders for our crowd scenes! Please fill out the interest form and select that you’re interested in being an extra.

Contact: peliculas.sin.leche@gmail.com

Run time: 12 minutes

Compensation: Unpaid; Crafty and meals provided.

Union status: Non-Union

Auditions: Please fill out our interest form, which you can access here (https://linktr.ee/peliculas.sin.leche), where you can also access our sides. Please submit self-tapes via our interest form. 

Please contact peliculas.sin.leche@gmail.com if you have any questions! 

Shooting schedule: We are planning to film November 7th, 8th, 14th, and 15th, exact schedules will be sent out ahead of shooting!

Location: Auraria Campus and Downtown Denver

Thanks everyone, I look forward to hearing from you!

# **VOICE ACTORS - CASTING CALL**

**Title**: God Is A Pelican - stop-motion animated short film

**Logline**: “God is a Pelican” is a stop-motion animated short that follows two misfit middle-school girls’ intense, queer, and turbulent friendship as they create their own religion.

CASTING EXTRAS FOR SENIOR THESIS SHORT FILM ‼️‼️‼️

Hello, my name is Elliot Harrington and I am the producer of the upcoming short film called “Sponsored By”. It is about a divorced father who takes on coaching a Little League baseball team in hopes to impress his boss, get a promotion, and be invited to an exclusive BBQ.

Looking for:
- Individuals who read as 4-7 years of age (willing to accept submissions from individuals a few years older than 7)

Shooting Dates:
- September 26th: 10 AM-4 PM
- September 27th: 8 AM-2 PM
- October 3rd: 2 PM-8 PM
- October 4th: 10 AM-4 PM
- October 10th: 2 PM-8 PM 

Shooting Location: Loveland, CO

If you can make it to all these dates, congrats; you are a part of the home baseball team and have the opportunity for lines and more screen time.

If you can’t make it to all the dates and only some, congrats; you are a part of one of the away teams with no lines and less screen time.

Extras are unpaid, but will receive IMDb credit. All minors must have a parent with them present on set 24/7. We need adult extras as well, so instead of parents just sitting around, they have the opportunity to be in the bleachers, cheering on the team.

If you are interested, or know anyone who is interested, please reach out to me with your availability and your headshot. You can message me here or email me @ elliot.m.harrington@gmail.com

Thank you!

**NORWEGIAN AURA CASTING AUDITIONS**
**NON-UNION**

Norwegian Cruise Line is currently seeking **Production Dancers, Singers, Specialty Vocalists, and Aerialists** for original mainstage productions debuting aboard the newest vessel, the Norwegian AURA.

The AURA will feature a brand-new concert/Las Vegas residency-style production centered around the musical legacy of Whitney Houston, following in the footsteps of *Revolution: A Celebration of Prince* aboard Norwegian AQUA and *Elton: A Celebration of Elton John* aboard Norwegian LUNA. Cast members may also participate in and/or cover other entertainment offerings including Welcome Aboard Shows, nightclub events, parties, and other experiences.

PRODUCTION DANCERS — LOS ANGELES

**Saturday, September 19, 2026**
**OPEN CALL — NO PRE-REGISTRATION REQUIRED**

**Mihran K. Studios**
135 N Victory Blvd
Burbank, CA 91502

Sign-in: **9:30 AM**
Audition begins: **10:00 AM**

Talent will be seen in the order in which they arrive. **Callbacks will be held the same afternoon.**

Female-identifying performers should be prepared to dance in both **heels and flats**. Male-identifying dancers should bring **sneakers and jazz shoes**. Please bring a hard copy headshot and resume. All dancers should wear form-fitting dance attire and be prepared to learn multiple combinations.

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile dancers with a strong technical foundation and training in a wide range of styles spanning commercial jazz, contemporary, hip-hop, and more. The ability to partner and lift or be lifted is a must. Strong performance quality, audience engagement, and storytelling are essential. Tumbling/acro is a plus, and certain dancers will be trained in various aerial skills during the rehearsal process. **All ethnicities. Singing is not required. Must be 18+.**

**DANCERS: $1,000/week ($4,350/month) onboard**

**Full Los Angeles audition information:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

SINGERS & SPECIALTY VOCALISTS — LOS ANGELES

**Sunday, September 20, 2026**
**BY APPOINTMENT ONLY **

Seeking Production Singers and Specialty Vocalists. Specialty Vocalists should be seasoned vocalist entertainers with strong pop, gospel and R&B backgrounds, while Production Singers should be charismatic performers with strong contemporary pop, rock and R&B skills, tight harmonies, and the ability to move or dance well.

**Specialty Vocalists: $1,730/week ($7,500/month)**
**Singers: $1,200/week ($5,200/month)**

To be considered for an appointment, submit through Breakdown Services, Actors Access, or the audition link below. Selected applicants will receive audition location, time, and additional details by email.

**Full Los Angeles audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/losangeles_aura_sept2026.html)

AERIALISTS — LAS VEGAS

**Tuesday, September 22, 2026**
**BY INVITATION ONLY **

Seeking athletic, dynamic, versatile gymnasts/acrobats and aerial artists with expertise in skills including **Silks, Straps, Bungee, Cube, Hand Balancing, and Acro/tumbling**. Strong upper-body strength and physical presence are required. Dance training and an understanding of body lines and positions are a major plus. The ability to engage an audience, embody a character, and tell a story is essential.

**Aerialists: $1,350/week ($5,850/month) onboard**

Pre-registration is required. To be considered for an appointment, submit through the link below. Selected applicants will receive the audition location, time, and additional details by email. **Male and female identifying. All ethnicities. Must be 18+.**

**Full Las Vegas audition information & submission:**
[https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html](https://nclhcreativestudios.com/2026_auditions/lasvegas_aura_sept2026.html)

Bright Star Touring Theatre, the nation’s largest provider of theatre for youth audiences, is currently seeking an Indigenous actor for our 2-person national tour. We are accepting performers of all gender identities for a tour that includes the shows: “Peter Pan”, “Cherokee Tales”, and “The Pirate of Bully Bay”.

This is a paid opportunity, including a compensated rehearsal period, with travel and lodging provided for the duration of the contract. Rehearsal begins in Raleigh, NC on October 4th, and the tour runs through November 24th. Compensation is set at $500/week, including the lodging and tour vehicle.

Applicants should have professional theatre training and experience (a theatre degree is preferable), a valid driver's license, as well as a clean driving and criminal record. We are currently only accepting applicants who are 21 or older. We are looking for strong character actors who are self motivated, independent, and want to travel to exciting, new places!

Please submit your headshot, resume, and availability to hunter@brightstartheatre.com to be considered. We will be conducting virtual auditions on an ongoing basis.

🎞️ SUNIL BABBAR TALES
(Reflections On Indian Cinema)

🎬 "AANDHI"-When Love and Life Took Different Roads...

Some love stories are about people coming together.

Some are about people staying together.

And then there are stories about two people who love each other deeply—but discover that love alone cannot always decide the direction of a life.

Gulzar's "Aandhi" (1975) is one such film.

Starring Suchitra Sen and Sanjeev Kumar, "Aandhi" is, at its heart, the story of Aarti and J.K.—two people whose marriage could not survive the different paths they chose, but whose emotional bond never completely disappeared.

Years later, when they meet again, the film doesn't rush towards melodrama.

Instead, it gives them something much more interesting:

TIME:

Time to remember.

Time to regret.

Time to smile.

And time to quietly understand what they had lost.

Suchitra Sen's Aarti is a fascinating character because she is neither presented as completely right nor completely wrong.

She is a woman with ambition, determination and a life of her own.

And Sanjeev Kumar's J.K. is equally beautifully written.

He has built a modest, peaceful existence for himself. He isn't waiting dramatically for Aarti to return.

But when she does, we understand that some memories never really leave us.

That emotional restraint is one of the film's greatest strengths.

As a filmmaker, I find this particularly beautiful.

Gulzar trusts the audience.

He doesn't explain every emotion.

A look can replace a conversation.

A pause can carry years of history.

A song can say what the characters themselves cannot.

And that brings us to one of the greatest strengths of "Aandhi"—its music.

R. D. Burman and Gulzar created songs that became part of the emotional architecture of the film.

'Tere Bina Zindagi Se Koi Shikwa To Nahin...'

'Tum Aa Gaye Ho Noor Aa Gaya...'

'Is Mod Se Jaate Hain...'

With the voices of Lata Mangeshkar and Kishore Kumar, these songs don't feel like interruptions to the narrative.

They feel like memories.

Feelings.

Unspoken conversations.

Even today, they carry the extraordinary ability to make us pause.

And perhaps that is the greatest achievement of "Aandhi".

It doesn't tell us that one person was right and the other was wrong.

It simply asks us to understand them.

Can two people still love each other when their lives have taken different directions?

There is no easy answer.

And perhaps there shouldn't be one.

Because real relationships rarely fit into neat cinematic conclusions.

"Aandhi" is also a beautiful reminder that a film does not require constant action to hold our attention.

Sometimes, character is action.

Sometimes, silence is dialogue.

🎞️ SUNIL BABBAR TALES
(Reflections On Indian Cinema)

🎬 "AANDHI"-When Love and Life Took Different Roads...

Some love stories are about people coming together.

Some are about people staying together.

And then there are stories about two people who love each other deeply—but discover that love alone cannot always decide the direction of a life.

Gulzar's "Aandhi" (1975) is one such film.

Starring Suchitra Sen and Sanjeev Kumar, "Aandhi" is, at its heart, the story of Aarti and J.K.—two people whose marriage could not survive the different paths they chose, but whose emotional bond never completely disappeared.

Years later, when they meet again, the film doesn't rush towards melodrama.

Instead, it gives them something much more interesting:

TIME:

Time to remember.

Time to regret.

Time to smile.

And time to quietly understand what they had lost.

Suchitra Sen's Aarti is a fascinating character because she is neither presented as completely right nor completely wrong.

She is a woman with ambition, determination and a life of her own.

And Sanjeev Kumar's J.K. is equally beautifully written.

He has built a modest, peaceful existence for himself. He isn't waiting dramatically for Aarti to return.

But when she does, we understand that some memories never really leave us.

That emotional restraint is one of the film's greatest strengths.

As a filmmaker, I find this particularly beautiful.

Gulzar trusts the audience.

He doesn't explain every emotion.

A look can replace a conversation.

A pause can carry years of history.

A song can say what the characters themselves cannot.

And that brings us to one of the greatest strengths of "Aandhi"—its music.

R. D. Burman and Gulzar created songs that became part of the emotional architecture of the film.

'Tere Bina Zindagi Se Koi Shikwa To Nahin...'

'Tum Aa Gaye Ho Noor Aa Gaya...'

'Is Mod Se Jaate Hain...'

With the voices of Lata Mangeshkar and Kishore Kumar, these songs don't feel like interruptions to the narrative.

They feel like memories.

Feelings.

Unspoken conversations.

Even today, they carry the extraordinary ability to make us pause.

And perhaps that is the greatest achievement of "Aandhi".

It doesn't tell us that one person was right and the other was wrong.

It simply asks us to understand them.

Can two people still love each other when their lives have taken different directions?

There is no easy answer.

And perhaps there shouldn't be one.

Because real relationships rarely fit into neat cinematic conclusions.

"Aandhi" is also a beautiful reminder that a film does not require constant action to hold our attention.

Sometimes, character is action.

Sometimes, silence is dialogue.

And sometimes, the most powerful drama is simply two people sitting across from each other, knowing everything that has happened between them.

🎥 If you haven't watched "Aandhi", please search for it online and watch the complete film.

Don't watch it merely as an old Hindi film.

Watch it for Gulzar's storytelling, Suchitra Sen and Sanjeev Kumar's performances, R. D. Burman's music, and the extraordinary emotional restraint of the filmmaking.

Good films deserve to be watched.

Good filmmakers deserve to be remembered.

And sometimes, the best way to understand a great film is simply to sit down and experience it.

— Sunil Babbar
Filmmaker | Actor | Director

(Reflections on the films and filmmakers who shaped Indian cinema)

WROCŁAW | 22 WRZEŚNIA | SZUKAM MODELKI DO SESJI 📸🍷

22 września we Wrocławiu realizuję sesję zdjęciową w wyjątkowych wnętrzach inspirowanych modernizmem lat 50.- 70. i Italian Mid-Century Modern. Drewno, stal, światło, architektura z charakterem - i kieliszek wina jako jeden z motywów sesji.

Szukam modelki do klimatycznych, eleganckich zdjęć, w których ważna będzie nie tylko osoba, ale również samo wnętrze i jego architektura.

Stawka: 250 zł/h.

Wybrane fotografie po sesji zostaną przygotowane i oprawione w passe-partout jako prace do ekspozycji na ścianie. Za wykorzystanie zdjęć w tej formie przewidziane jest dodatkowe wynagrodzenie 1200 zł - zgodnie z umową.

Najchętniej osoba z Wrocławia, ale jeśli jesteś z innego miasta i pomysł Cię zainteresował - również napisz, możemy porozmawiać o organizacji.

Wnętrza mogą być również dostępne przy kolejnych realizacjach.

Moje fotografie podróżnicze, a także kadry, w których coraz więcej miejsca zajmuje architektura i człowiek w przestrzeni, znajdziesz na Instagramie @wycieczko.

Zainteresowana? Napisz komentarz - odezwę się.

Szukamy **scenografa / scenografki do 2. dniowej produkcji reklamowej.**

**24-25.09**
**Warszawa **

Mamy kilka scen do przygotowania:

– **Styczniowy salon** – salon, z lekkimi pozostałościami po świętach - pojedyncze elementy, które jeszcze naturalnie mogły zostać w domu, na koniec stycznia
– **Wigilia rodzinna** – ten sam salon + jadalnia, ale już pełna świąteczna aranżacja: choinka, stół, dekoracje, bombki, dodatki itd.
– **Wigilia firmowa** – open space / przestrzeń biurowa z subtelną świąteczną scenografią

Najważniejszy organizacyjnie będzie drugi dzień zdjęciowy. Zaczynamy od scen ze Styczniowym salonem, a mniej więcej w połowie dnia robimy przestawkę tego samego wnętrza na Wigilię. Zależy nam więc na kimś, kto dobrze zaplanuje tę zmianę i będzie w stanie sprawnie przeprowadzić ją na planie z pomocą ekipy.

Nie oczekujemy też, że wszystko trzeba będzie kupować lub wypożyczać od zera. Jeśli część rzeczy da się zebrać od nas / ekipy  (bombki, ozdoby, światełka, dekoracje, zastawa itp.), to chętnie w ten sposób odciążymy scenografię i budżet. 

Ważniejsze jest dla nas dobre oko, spójność całości i sensowne zaplanowanie tego, co faktycznie trzeba zorganizować.

Po stronie scenografa/scenografki:
– przygotowanie koncepcji na bazie scenariusza i referencji,
– dobór dekoracji i rekwizytów,
– sourcing / wypożyczenia / zakupy tam, gdzie będą potrzebne,
– przygotowanie planu i styling scen,
– obecność na planie,
– sprawna przestawka ze Styczniowego salonu na Wigilię.

Podsyłacie proszę portfolio, dostępność i orientacyjną stawkę za współpracę na** **karmello.reklamy@gmail.com

CASTING CALL – “ALONE” | Independent Short Film

We are casting the lead role for Alone, an independent short film set in the present day and the past.

The film follows a young man who wakes alone in a car park with no memory of how he got there, gradually trying to piece together what has happened.

Role: Male lead
Playing age: 20–30
Experience: Previous acting experience is welcome but absolutely not essential.

The role will involve some physical performance, so applicants should be comfortable with this. Further details will be provided before filming.

Filming will take place over one full day at several locations in/around North Wiltshire. The exact filming date will be agreed with the successful actor once availability has been discussed.

This is currently an unpaid independent production although lunch will be provided. [Unfortunately, we are unable to cover travel expenses.]

[The successful actor will receive a copy of the finished film and footage suitable for use in a showreel.]

To apply, please email hg.film.creations@gmail.com with the subject: Alone – Short Film Application

Please include:

- A recent headshot/photo
- Your age
- Your location
- Any relevant acting experience (although no previous experience is required)

Shortlisted applicants will be sent a short extract from the script and asked to record a brief self-tape audition.

Thank you — I look forward to hearing from you.

topComments.text: If you can't cover travel as a minimum dude you shouldn't be making a film. Actors at the very least shouldn't be out of pocket to work.

items.text:
🎬 Poszukiwana ekipa i aktorzy do amatorskiego serialu w Koszalinie! 🎥

Hej! Razem z przyjaciółką ruszamy z  projektem i szukamy zakręconych, pełnych pasji ludzi, którzy chcą wspólnie stworzyć coś wyjątkowego! 

Spędziłam ostatnio sporo czasu nad scenariuszem do naszego własnego serialu i nadszedł moment, żeby przelać go na ekran.

Na ten moment mamy już obsadzone dwie role (gramy ja i moja przyjaciółka), ale projekt jest duży i potrzebujemy Was! 

Kogo szukamy? (Wszystkie role grane z własnej woli, projekt non-profit na start):

* Aktorów/Aktorek (wiek ok. 15-17 lat): Szukamy aż 6 osób (2 dziewczyn i 4 chłopaków) do głównych ról oraz kilku osób do ról pobocznych! ( Na tą chwilę 3 dziewczyny, mogą być chłopacy) Nie musisz mieć doświadczenia, liczą się chęci i dobra zabawa.

* Aktorów/Aktorek (wiek ok. 30 lat): Potrzebujemy 1 lub 2 starszych postaci, które idealnie dopełnią naszą historię.

* Kamerzysty/Operatora: Jeśli kręci Cię praca z kamerą (nawet jeśli dopiero zaczynasz lub nagrywasz dobrym telefonem/aparatem) – zapraszamy!

* Stażystów / Pomocy na planie: Osób, które chcą zobaczyć, jak wygląda tworzenie filmu od kulis, pomóc przy organizacji, dźwięku czy rekwizytach.

📍 Gdzie nagrywamy? Koszalin i okolice.💰(Do ustalenia, które dokładnie miejsca) 
Kwestie finansowe: 
Tworzymy to czysto hobbystycznie i dla zajawki, więc na początku nie oferujemy wynagrodzenia. Jeśli jednak nasz serial zacznie w przyszłości zarabiać (np. na YouTube czy innych platformach), zarobkami dzielimy się wspólnie! To świetna okazja do zbudowania portfolio.

Jeśli masz wolny czas, chcesz przeżyć super przygodę, poznać nowych znajomych i stworzyć coś, czym będziemy mogli się pochwalić – napisz do mnie w wiadomości prywatnej! Napisz parę słów o sobie, a ja postaram się dobrać rolę (oczywiście jak ktoś chce sam wybrać proszę to napisać, a prześlę dostępne role). 💬

(Uwaga! Jeśli ktoś nagra z nami np pierwszy sezon i stwierdzi, że nie chce nagrywać dalej to będziemy musieli nagrywać od nowa. Moja prośba jest taka, że jeśli ktoś się zdecyduje na dołączenie to prosimy o zostanie z nami do końca. Na tą chwilę mam napisane 4 sezony - przewidziany 5 sezon - nie mam pojęcia jak to się rozwinie i ile będzie sezonów. Oczywiście scenariusze będą podlegać zmianie!)

items.text:
🎬 POSZUKUJEMY AKTORA – „MĄCKI”

Cześć! 👋

Poszukujemy aktora do roli Mąckiego w naszym filmie krótkometrażowym, realizowanym w ramach niezależnej produkcji studenckiej non-profit.

Mącki to jeden z ważniejszych bohaterów epizodycznych — szkolny bully, który wraz ze swoją grupą prześladuje głównego bohatera. To pewny siebie, dominujący typ, który lubi pokazywać swoją przewagę nad innymi. Jest bezpośredni, zaczepny i nie boi się konfrontacji.

🎭 Kogo szukamy?

👤 Mężczyzna
💈 Łysy / całkowicie ogolona głowa – to jeden z ważniejszych elementów wyglądu postaci
🎒 Wiek najlepiej odpowiadający wiekowi szkolnemu
🧍 Charakterystyczna, wyrazista aparycja
🎥 Naturalność przed kamerą i umiejętność zagrania bardziej agresywnej, dominującej postaci

Doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest konieczne — liczy się przede wszystkim odpowiedni charakter i naturalność przed kamerą.

📅 Zdjęcia: 3–4 października
📍 Poznań
🎬 Film krótkometrażowy, studencki, niezależny, non-profit

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany, napisz do nas na:

📩 email.od.filmow@gmail.com

W zgłoszeniu napisz kilka słów o sobie i podeślij aktualne zdjęcie. Jeśli masz doświadczenie aktorskie lub materiały wideo, również możesz je dołączyć.

Jeżeli znasz kogoś, kto idealnie pasowałby do tej roli — podeślij mu ogłoszenie! 🎬🔥

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas

items.text:
Hi all me again ☺️

I am looking for the opportunity to work on some unique and exciting projects. I am an actress based within the West Midlands fairly local to Birmingham and easy connections via train to London or further up north. I have a valid DBS and I am open to working on Student films, Short, Films along with feature films or mini series anything really that gives me the opportunity to act as I don’t yet have a showreel but I am SPOTLIGHT listed. 

I am very drawn to horror especially paranormal and folklore and period stuff. I also love dramas, action and mysteries. 

Some of my favourite movies and shows are

Hemlock Grove - series 
IT Movie Welcome to Derry - series
Stranger Things - Series
Doctor Who - Series
The Conjuring  (Universe)- Movie
The Crow - Movie
John Wick - Movie
Saw - Movie
Final Destination 3 - Movie

I have on SET experience as I have worked on two big Bollywood movies with some of India’s famous actors but I have also worked on two smaller SETs. I have experience working inside and outside including doing a water shoot which involved getting soaked with water. I’m also willing to be a stand in or a body double.

I would love to also get into scare acting over the Halloween period 🙂

If you feel you have something that you feel would suit me I would love to hear from you. 

Many thanks ☺️

items.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL — DAY PLAYERS / SUPPORTING ROLES
HI HONEY (shooting from 20-30 Sept) 
An independent UK feature film exploring love, grief and loss. A bunch of graduates are making a feature film with collaborative support! 

We’re currently casting a number of day-player and supporting roles for filming in London.
ROLES
BOSS — Professional, authoritative presence. Open ethnicity/gender.
• ALEX — Caring partner, Supporting role.
• ⁠CUSTOMER — Small day-player role,non speaking 
• FUNERAL ATTENDANT- small day player role
• FUNERAL ATTENDANT 1
• FUNERAL ATTENDANT 2
• FUNERAL ATTENDANT 3
• ⁠FUNERAL ATTENDANT- emotionally supportive, non speaking
• ⁠A COUPLE IN THE SHOP — Looking for two performers who can naturally play a couple. Non speaking roles. 
• ATTENDEE — SUPPORT GROUP — Emotionally grounded supporting role, non speaking
• PRIEST — Minimal speaking role. Warm, composed and believable ceremonial presence.
• ⁠ELLA- minimal speaking role, wedding& funeral scenes 

• ⁠📍 Location: London
🎥 Production: Independent / crowdfunded feature film
💷 Expenses Only
📅 Filming across selected dates in September
We welcome performers of all ethnicities and backgrounds, unless otherwise specified above.
To apply, please send:
Name / Age range / Role you’re applying for / Headshot / Spotlight or Showreel if available / London base / Availability
Please only apply if you are comfortable working on a small independent passion project with a collaborative cast and crew.

meghna.upadhyay2@gmail.com

HI HONEY is being made by filmmakers coming together because we believe in the story and want to create something meaningful around grief, connection and the people we leave behind.

items.text:
**CASTING CALL EXPERIMENTAL FICTION SHORT DRAMA, COPENHAGEN (UNPAID)**

We are looking for native English-speaking actors for an upcoming experimental fiction project set in Copenhagen in early October. The project is being produced in collaboration with Minehubs Studios.

The production is unpaid, but travel expenses related to the shoot will be covered, and meals and refreshments will be provided during filming.

We are currently casting the following roles:

Andrew (Male), 40–60

The VP of his father’s company. He will do almost anything to earn his father’s recognition.

Mr. Ashford / Lawyer (Male), 40–70

A clever man who is never taking anyone’s side. He never reveals more than absolutely necessary.

Sarah (Female), 40–60

Determined to make amends for the terrible things her father has done. However, she finds herself facing the consequences on her own.

Leona (Female), 60–70

She has spent her entire life waiting for the chance to take revenge on Robert by claiming the entire inheritance, and has little concern for the people who have helped him.

To apply, please send:

• A recent and recognizable photo of yourself

• Your CV and/or details of any previous acting experience, if available

• Which role you would like to be considered for

Please send applications to js@minehubsstudios.com

We look forward to hearing from you.

Project Title: The Final Showdown

Format: Short Scene / Proof of Concept (3 mins)

Compensation: Unpaid / Voluntary (Credit & Portfolio Building)

Location: Remote (Film from home using your own smartphone and Green Screen/Backdrop)

Character Profile:

KAYD (Male, 20-21, Open Ethnicity): A brave, smart, and resilient survivor trapped in a dark, mutated virus outbreak environment. Requires intense emotional acting (terror, brutal physical pain reaction, and a fierce, exhausted comeback). 

Project Details:

The post-production crew is 100% complete and highly professional on Discord (VFX artists/Compositors using Nuke, and a Hollywood-level Music Composer). We have a shot-by-shot 5-take breakdown ready for you to film this week. 

How to Apply:

If you are interested and ready to film your action takes, please send a DM right away with your headshot and voice/acting reel. Let's create something cinematic together! 🎬🔥☣️

CASTING CALL — Florida & Surrounding States
DEFIANCE
Non-Union, Paid Roles
Filming in Florida: January 29 – February 17, 2027
From 3 Rats Entertainment, the team behind Killer Grannies, Bad Bunny, Extortion Thugs, The American Ripper, Snarly Yow, and Amityville: Mt. Misery Road, comes a new historical feature.
Florida, December 28, 1835. Major Francis L. Dade leads over 100 U.S. soldiers north toward Fort King through Florida's wilderness, unaware that warriors are watching their every move. Within hours, the encounter will erupt into one of the most consequential battles in Florida history, helping ignite the Second Seminole War.
Now Casting
We are seeking performers throughout Florida and surrounding states for the following roles:
Women to play historical settlers
Men to play soldiers
Experience with period flintlock muskets, historical reenactment, horseback riding, wilderness skills, or combat performance is a plus, but not required.
How to Submit
Send submissions to Karolina & Flor, Casting Directors — 3 Rats Entertainment
Email: 3ratsentertainment@gmail.com
Please include:
Several current photographs
Acting or reenactment experience
Film credits, if applicable
Flintlock musket experience, if applicable
Horseback riding experience, if applicable
Current city and state
Please share this casting call.

AUDITION: MÆND SØGES TIL MUSICAL 🎭 
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig den sidste ekstra-audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu, hvor du også kan læse alle rollebeskrivelser: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere til store roller samt solister og dansere af alle køn! Samtlige pladser/roller i forestillingen er stadig åbne.

Nye auditiondatoer: Lørdag/søndag d. 26.-27. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet samt dansere.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

Læs mere om audition og tilmeld dig her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

sharedPost.text:
EKSTRA-AUDITION PÅ MUSICAL 🎭 
Skuespillere, sangere, dansere og ensemble søges til genopsætningen af Musicalteatrets originale, anmelderroste og storsælgende thrillermusical fra 2019, “JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”, skrevet og instrueret af Rasmus Mansachs (skaberen af bl.a. “Vi maler byen rød: The Musical” og “Jeg tror det kaldes kærlighed: The Musical”). Vil du være med i en seriøs, dramatisk, chokerende, rørende og anderledes dansk teaterproduktion, hvor man bogstaveligt talt kommer helt ud over scenekanten? Tilmeld dig audition hos hovedstadsområdets største musicalforening nu, hvor du også kan læse alle rollebeskrivelser: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op er velkomne, og vi søger især flere tilmeldinger fra mandlige skuespillere og/eller sangere samt solister og dansere af alle køn! Samtlige pladser/roller i forestillingen er stadig åbne.

Nye auditiondato: Lørdag/søndag d. 26.-27. september 2026.
Der søges: Ca. 50 skuespillere, sangere og/eller dansere i alle køn og aldre fra 18 år og op (erfaring er ikke et krav) til de 14 bærende roller og ca. 30 personer til ensemblet samt dansere.
Øveperiode: 8. oktober 2026 – 1. marts 2027.
Øvested: Teaterhuset Borgen på Frederiksberg.
Forestillingsdatoer: 3.-20. marts 2027.
Spillested: Folketeatrets Store Turnéscene i København.
OBS: Det er muligt at tilmelde sig “kun” som danser eller ensemble uden sang/replikker, hvis man ikke ønsker at synge kor eller have replikker i forestillingen.
Musicalteatret er en teaterforening, og det er derfor ulønnet at medvirke på scenen.
Auditiontilmelding: musicalteatret.dk/audition

Musicalteatret præsenterer:
“JACK THE RIPPER: THE MUSICAL”
Instruktør: Rasmus Mansachs
Sanginstruktør/korleder: Johnny Jørgensen
Koreograf: Anne-Cathrine Albæk
Manuskript: Rasmus Mansachs
Originalsange: Lars Rahbek Andresen & Rasmus Mansachs

Læs mere om audition og tilmeld dig her: musicalteatret.dk/audition

✅ Paid training

🚗 Free on-site parking

🍽️ Free hot meal on every shift

👗 Professional costume & wardrobe provided

🎟️ NOW BOOKING AUDITIONS!

📣 CASTING – POSZUKUJEMY MĘŻCZYZNY 50–75LAT 📣

Do promocyjnego filmu towarzyszącego wydarzeniu kulturalnemu poszukujemy mężczyzny w wieku 50–75 lat do roli RYBAKA 🎣

Szukamy osoby z naturalną energią, otwartością, pogodnym usposobieniem i radością życia. Mile widziane jest zamiłowanie do wędkowania lub doświadczenie w łowieniu ryb, ale nie jest to warunek konieczny. Najważniejsza jest dla nas autentyczność, swoboda i naturalność przed kamerą.

🎬 Nagrania: jutro, w pierwszej połowie dnia

⏱️ Czas pracy: ok. 3 godziny

💰 Wynagrodzenie: 100 zł

Jeśli jesteś zainteresowany lub znasz kogoś, kto idealnie pasuje do tego opisu, zostaw komentarz pod postem lub napisz do nas wiadomość prywatną.

Będziemy również bardzo wdzięczni za udostępnienie ogłoszenia – może właśnie dzięki Tobie znajdziemy naszego bohatera! 🎣

🎤 **Street Interviewer Wanted – Germany**

We’re looking for someone based in a **major German city** to conduct street interviews for Lio.

You’ll approach people, ask about their **smoking/vaping habits**, let them try Lio, and capture their reactions. Lio mimics the familiar sensation and ritual of smoking/vaping without nicotine, smoke, or vapor, helping people quit while keeping the habit.

**€50/hour — approx. 3 hours per session.**

We’ll send you the product beforehand.

If the content performs well, we’d love to make this a **long-term collaboration**.

Interested? Please send me a PM

Schauspielersuche:
Für den Kurzfilm "AT : Es stand Alles im Wahlprogramm"
sind folgende Rollen zu besetzen 

- Arabisch /Türkischer Mann ca. 20 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkischer Mann ca 50 - 60 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca. 27 Jahre alt
-Arabisch / Türkische Frau ca. 27 Jahre alt
- Deutscher Mann ca 45 Jahre alt
- Deutsche Frau, blond, ca 45 Jahre alt

Filminhalt :
Ein rechtradikaler Politiker sonnt sich nach einer Wahl  in seinem Erfolg.
Aber die Fassade bröckelt. Eine bittere  Politsatire. 

Aufgrund des aktuellen Bezuges sollte der Dreh schnell erfolgen, daher kann jeder Schauspieler seine Rolle am Laptop oder Smartphone selber Filmen. 
Der Film soll dann kostenfrei auf you Tube gestellt werden und jeder kann den Film sofort nutzen. Es geht darum den Film zu verbreiten, daher auch leider keine Bezahlung,  da kein Geld verdient werden kann. 
Ich hoffe es finden sich Schauspieler, die sich gegen den Rechtsradikalismus stellen und Charakter zeigen.

Ich bin Thomas Goersch,  Schauspieler und Filmregisseur www.imdb.com/name/nm1591928
Meldet Euch unter Thomas.Goersch@vodafonemail.de 
Bis dann
Thomas

Dzień dobry, szukam pracy na Terenie Warszawy.

items.text:
Chagrin Valley Little Theatre is excited to continue its 2026-2027 Season! 

 

AUDITIONS FOR DEATHTRAP

Secure your time slot now before they fill up!

 

Auditions for 

Deathtrap

by Ira Levin

 

Directed by Chris Bizub

 

AUDITION DATES:

Sunday, October 11th from 7:00pm to 10:00pm

Monday, October 12th from 7:00pm to 10:00pm

 

CALLBACKS:

Callbacks will be Wednesday, October 14th from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM

 

PERFORMANCES:

January 22nd, 2027 - February 7th, 2027

Fridays & Saturdays at 7:30 PM

Sundays at 2:00 PM

 

REHEARSALS:

Rehearsals will take place Sundays thru Thursday from 7:00pm to 10:00pm. Rehearsals begin November 15th.

 

LOCATION:

Chagrin Valley Little Theatre

40 River Street

Chagrin Falls, OH 44022

 

[https://cvlt.org/](https://cvlt.org/)

 

SIGN-UP FOR AN AUDITION SLOT:

Schedule your time slot by signing up via the link below…

 

[CLICK HERE TO SIGN UP FOR A GROUP AUDITION SLOT](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/30E0548ADAF2BA6F94-64300021-auditions#/)

 

WHAT TO PREPARE:

*Actors should bring a headshot or recent picture, and resume (if you have one)

*A list of conflicts from November 15th to February 7th

*Auditions will consist of readings from the script

 

AUDITION/REHEARSAL LOCATION:

Chagrin Valley Little Theatre

40 River Street

Chagrin Falls, OH 44022

 

SYNOPSIS:

In Ira Levin’s classic comedic thriller, Deathtrap, a washed-up playwright finds a chance to rise to the top once more, a shot he’d be willing to kill for. Sidney Bruhl hasn’t written a hit play for 18 years when he receives a script from a former student, Clifford Anderson, that’s a guaranteed success. His wife, Myra, suggests the two men could collaborate; Sidney jokes that it’d be just as easy to murder the young man and steal the script for his own. When Clifford arrives later that evening, no one--not even the visiting psychic--could predict where the dark events of the night will go.

CHARACTERS:

Any age, race, ethnicity, national origin, gender, body type, abilities, or other identities are encouraged to audition and will be considered equally in character casting, unless directly specified by the playwright as integral to their story. Age/age ranges, genders, and descriptions, if listed, are recommendations by the script but are flexible to interpretation. No roles for this production have been precast unless otherwise stated in marketing announcements regarding the auditions.

SIDNEY BRUHL (Male Presenting. Mid 40s-60s) - A once acclaimed author fallen victim to a recent creative drought. He’s usually the smartest and most charming one in the room and wants to make sure everyone else in the room knows it. Sidney is extremely ambitious and will do almost anything to get what he wants, no matter who might be in his way.

CLIFFORD ANDERSON (Male Presenting. 20s-30s) - An attractive and talented young writer with a bright future ahead of him. He’s usually the smartest and most charming one in the room but is fine with biding his time to let people find that out. He is extremely clever and can easily slip on fronts of innocence and naivety that belies some of his darker ambitions.

MYRA BRUHL (Female Presenting. Mid 40s to 60s) - Sidney’s loving and supportive wife. She is a kind and calming presence during some of Sidney’s stormier moods. Her soft exterior will give way to a much firmer attitude when she needs to get Sidney off of some of his more unhealthy notions.

HELGA TEN DORP (Female Presenting. 30+. Has a Dutch accent.*) - Celebrity Psychic who loves every minute of her fame. She is free spirited, and not easily intimidated.
*Actors auditioning for Helga are encouraged to attempt her accent in their audition, but are not required to if not comfortable.*

PORTER MILGRIM ( Male Presenting. 30+.) Sidney’s friend and attorney.
Very sharp and observant of his surroundings. Isn’t sure he trusts
Clifford. 

 

OTHER DETAILS:

Chagrin Valley Community Theatre is a 501c3 Non-Profit Organization. All actors cast are strictly volunteers. No AEA Contract(s) available.

If you have any questions or would like to audition for this production, but are unable to attend regular auditions, please contact the director at [bizchris85@gmail.com](mailto:bizchris85@gmail.com) feel free to reach out with any questions you may have regarding the production.

Panel Light vs. Ring Light: Which is best for your self-tape? 🎬👇

​There are two major contenders for the best compact lighting setup, and they create very different results on camera.

​⭕ RING LIGHTS
• ​Best for: Elimination of shadows, great for beauty content/vlogging.

• ​The Catch: Leaves circular reflections in your eyes and flattens your facial features.

​☀️ PANEL LIGHTS
• ​Best for: Soft, cinematic fill, mimicking natural daylight.

• ​The Edge: Replicates natural light without distracting eye reflections and adds depth when positioned at 45°.

​🏆 VERDICT: For acting self-tapes, Panel Lights are generally preferred for a natural look!

​Which light setup do you currently use for your tapes? Let us know! 💡

#acting #selftape #actors #manchester

Register for free and build your photo portfolio (we'll help you with this).

The entire process is completely legal and 100% secure.
You relax while your likeness earns money for you! 💸

We are excited to announce our next 4-week Hollyoaks Adult Acting Course starting this November for actors aged 16+. For the very first time, we will have both Hollyoaks Casting Directors—Peter Hunt and Gill Charnock—in together to watch your performances.

During the final week on 6th December, participants will take part in a mock casting in front of Peter and Gill. They will be giving notes, feedback, and direction on each individual performance. We have had a fantastic success rate from our previous Hollyoaks courses, with past attendees securing auditions and roles after meeting the casting directors.

Course Schedule & Details:

  - Week 1: Sunday 15th November 2026, 5:00pm – 7:00pm
  - Week 2: Sunday 22nd November 2026, 2:00pm – 4:00pm
  - Week 3: Sunday 29th November 2026, 2:00pm – 4:00pm
  - Week 4 (Mock Casting): Sunday 6th December 2026, 10:00am – 12:00pm

Fee: £145

Click here to book https://screenplayacting.com/product/hollyoaks-c4-lime-pictures-nov-dec-2026/

Address:
Studio 96, Unit 1A and 1B, Sundance Court
Kansas Avenue, Salford, Media City, M50 2GZ

If you have any trouble finding the location on the day, you can call us on 07531007738 or contact info@screenplayacting.com

Please note: We do not offer refunds, but we do offer course transfers. Transfers must be used within a 6-month period.

items.text:
Hi everyone — posting on behalf of Title Productions Ltd in Bolton.

We're launching a YouTube documentary channel covering financial fraud, heists, and corporate collapse, produced to a cinematic standard.

We're looking for a presenter. One session per month, couple of hours, batch filming. Full scripts, teleprompter, all production support. £250 per session, monthly ongoing.

The persona is set to be calm, dry, and intelligent — not high energy, not broadcast news. Someone who can hold a camera with stillness and let an extraordinary story do the work.

We're looking to cast someone between the age of 20 and 30, but are willing to consider all ages that apply.  

To apply, just send a 60-second video to paul@titleproltd.com along with a headshot and general showreel link. 

Tell us who you are and why this sounds like your kind of project.    

Recording will take place at our studio in Bolton within the next couple of months.  Exact dates still to be determined as soon as casting is finalised.

Unfortunetely, travel & Accommodation will not be covered for this project, so please consider this when looking at the payment, your distance to travel and your costs getting to us.

Any more questions, contact Paul at paul@titleproltd.com

Thanks for looking

URGENT : recherche H/F 25/55 ans en figuration et silhouettes pour le LUNDI 05 OCTOBRE ayant déjà eu des expériences en tant que CROUPIER(E)S et quelques H/F style elites du sud/riviera/VIP/Bling-Bling tous ages, en particulier des hommes sur PARIS.
( priorité aux comédien( nes ), pas de candidature en MP et merci de VRAIMENT lire attentivement l’annonce jusqu’au bout avant de postuler 🙏🏻 )!

Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Dans le cadre du tournage d’une mini série pour une plate-forme je recherche des H et des F entre 25 et 55( âge apparent ), ayant de vraies aptitudes de croupiers( manipulation très rapide des cartes, connaissance des règles, manipulation des jetons, vocabulaire spécifique etc… )ou éventuellement de magiciens très expérimentés pour incarner des employés d’un cercle de jeu de St Tropez en 2005.

Tournage le LUNDI 05 OCTOBRE 2026 sur PARIS 16.
Horaires prévisionnels : 06h00/15h00

Merci de ne pas postuler si vous ne faites pas de figuration, d’indiquer vos disponibilités/indisponibilités entre le 18 SEPTEMBRE et le 14 OCTOBRE.

Pour tous : pas de défraiement transport, nous cherchons des gens sur Paris ! 🙂

Rémunération : tarif syndical figuration TV cachet 98 euros bruts( base 8h + 1h de repas )+ éventuelles heures sup/heures de nuit si il y a + éventuelle majoration silhouette de 42,24 euros si vous êtes retenus en silhouette.

Je cherche également quelques profils de clients très fortunés, bling-bling, peaux tannées par le soleil pour incarner quelques clients usés qui jouent en journée. 
L’action étant censée se passer dans le SUD, véritables sudistes, italiens, vrais anglophones/allemands bienvenus pour les sons seuls.

IMPORTANT : l’action est censée se dérouler en 2005, PAS de bouches TROP siliconnées, pas de sourcils carrés et très dessinés et pas de faux ongles très longs.
Pas de tatouages trop récents visibles.
Tribaux ok.

Si vous êtes intéressé(e)s, disponibles, que vous correspondez aux critères et que vous N’AVEZ PAS D’IMPÉRATIF HORAIRE sur le ou les jours pour lesquels vous postulez, merci de me faire parvenir votre candidature à l’adresse suivante : 

Uas.casting@gmail.com

IMPORTANT merci de préciser en OBJET de votre mail le décor avec la date pour laquelle vous postulez + votre spécificité, votre âge, NOM + Prénom, mensurations :  exemple «   05 OCTOBRE, CROUPIÈRE, Sophie MARTINEZ 25 ans, 1m75, 60kg » ou «  05 OCTOBRE,  ITALIEN, Gino FAUSTO 65 ans , 1m85, 85kg, etc… 

Votre CANDIDATURE doit comprendre si possible les éléments suivants :
-Vos indisponibilités( ou disponibilités )entre le 18 SEPTEMBRE et le 14 OCTOBRE
-VOS MENSURATIONS COMPLÈTES( taille, poids, veste, haut, pantalon, chaussures ) 
-Origines ethniques 
-Couleur des yeux
-Couleur des cheveux 
- NOM et Prénom (pas de pseudonyme)
- NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE 
-Date et lieu de naissance 
-Lieu de résidence( adresse complète )
-2 à 3 photos de vous récentes( dont portrait, en pied et un selfie pris aujourd’hui, sans filtre )
-Préciser si vous avez des expériences de service, des compétences particulières quelles qu’elles soient( magicien, croupier etc etc )
-Préciser si vous avez des tatouages, des piercings, des cheveux colorés etc.. 
-Préciser, si vous le souhaitez, si vous avez eu recours à la chirurgie esthétique 
-Préciser si vous avez des tenues très chic/luxe/gala. N’hésitez pas à envoyer des photos de vos tenues si vous le pouvez !
-Préciser si vous disposez de tenues en rapport avec de futurs potentiels décors( serveurs, sécu etc … )
N’hésitez pas à joindre des photos de vous en tenues si vous avez.
-Préciser toutes les langues que vous parlez et le niveau et tout accent spécifique que vous pourriez avoir 
-Un CV et une bande démo( si vous avez )pour mon fichier et pour d’éventuelles silhouettes.
-Des images de vous en train de manipuler des cartes éventuellement pour ceux qui postulent pour les employés du casino
-N’hésitez pas à préciser si vous avez des talents particuliers : cascade, sport à haut niveau, musicien, danseur, etc etc 
-Préciser si vous êtes autonomes et par quel moyen( voiture, scooter, vélo, trottinette etc )
-Préciser si vous êtes ok pour faire du co voiturage pour les personnes disposant d’une voiture
-Préciser la marque et la couleur de votre voiture 
-Des photos de votre voiture, scooter, vélo etc pour celles et ceux qui en ont.

Par avance désolée car je ne pourrai malheureusement pas répondre à tout le monde. Je vous re contacterai dès que possible si votre profil correspond. 

Merci par avance à toutes et à tous pour vos futurs envois et belle journée ! 🙂

Anne Arovas, assistée d’Angèle Chenais
Uas.casting@gmail.com

📣** NOUVEAU TOURNAGE - VIELSALM** 📣

Bonjour à toutes et tous,

Nous entamons la préparation d'un nouveau tournage, le long-métrage*** COMME UNE GRANDE*** réalisé par Adriana Da Fonseca.
Nous sommes essentiellement à la recherche de personnes sensibilisées par le sujet traité dans le film.

L'histoire nous présente Violette, une jeune femme trisomique qui vient d'emménager dans un centre. Elle découvre la liberté tout en devant faire face aux contraintes imposées par son handicap... ou par la société ?...

Nous recherchons :

**PERSONNES NEUROATYPIQUES**, porteuses de TRISOMIE ou en situation d'autres HANDICAPS INTELLECTUELS
pour jouer des résidents du foyer lors de scènes de vie, de fête ou d'activités

**PERSONNES sensibilisées au sujet abordé**
pour jouer des membres de la famille invités lors d'une fête, des éducateurs ou des membres du personnel soignant
____

**TOURNAGE DU 19 OCTOBRE AU 4 DÉCEMBRE**

**PLUSIEURS JOURS DE PRÉSENCE SOUHAITÉS**
**VIELSALM**
**60 € par jour**
____

Si vous connaissez des personnes correspondant à ces profils, n'hésitez pas à leur partager notre annonce.
Merci de postuler à l'adresse** blanche.castpro@gmail.com avec l'objet "Comme une Grande" et vos DISPONIBILITÉS**.

Merci d'envoyer également : NOM, PRÉNOM, DATE DE NAISSANCE, NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE, VILLE DE RÉSIDENCE et 2-3 PHOTOS.

Un grand merci d'avance et au plaisir de vous accueillir dans cette atmosphère calme et respectueuse,

Blanche Amphiarus-Deprée
Maxime Burton

📣** NOUVEAU TOURNAGE - VIELSALM** 📣

Bonjour à toutes et tous,

Nous entamons la préparation d'un nouveau tournage, le long-métrage*** COMME UNE GRANDE*** réalisé par Adriana Da Fonseca.
Nous sommes essentiellement à la recherche de personnes sensibilisées par le sujet traité dans le film.

L'histoire nous présente Violette, une jeune femme trisomique qui vient d'emménager dans un centre. Elle découvre la liberté tout en devant faire face aux contraintes imposées par son handicap... ou par la société ?...

Nous recherchons :

**PERSONNES NEUROATYPIQUES**, porteuses de TRISOMIE ou en situation d'autres HANDICAPS INTELLECTUELS
pour jouer des résidents du foyer lors de scènes de vie, de fête ou d'activités

**PERSONNES sensibilisées au sujet abordé**
pour jouer des membres de la famille invités lors d'une fête, des éducateurs ou des membres du personnel soignant
____

**TOURNAGE DU 19 OCTOBRE AU 4 DÉCEMBRE**

**PLUSIEURS JOURS DE PRÉSENCE SOUHAITÉS**
**VIELSALM**
**60 € par jour**
____

Si vous connaissez des personnes correspondant à ces profils, n'hésitez pas à leur partager notre annonce.
Merci de postuler à l'adresse** blanche.castpro@gmail.com avec l'objet "Comme une Grande" et vos DISPONIBILITÉS**.

Merci d'envoyer également : NOM, PRÉNOM, DATE DE NAISSANCE, NUMÉRO DE TÉLÉPHONE, VILLE DE RÉSIDENCE et 2-3 PHOTOS.

Un grand merci d'avance et au plaisir de vous accueillir dans cette atmosphère calme et respectueuse,

Blanche Amphiarus-Deprée
Maxime Burton

📸🎥 RECHERCHE MODÈLES – PHOTO & VIDÉO
📍 Villefranche-sur-Saône (69)

Dans le cadre du développement de notre studio, nous recherchons des personnes à l’aise devant l’objectif pour participer à différents shootings photo et tournages vidéo.

🎯 L’objectif : créer du contenu destiné à présenter et promouvoir le studio sur les réseaux sociaux et nos supports de communication.

En échange de votre participation :

✨ Vous repartez avec une sélection de photos professionnelles retouchées et filtrées

🎥 Possibilité également de récupérer certains contenus vidéo réalisés pendant la séance

💸 Aucune participation financière demandée

Aucune expérience de mannequin n’est nécessaire. Nous recherchons avant tout des profils naturels, motivés et à l’aise devant la caméra.

👩👨 Hommes & femmes

📸 Portraits, lifestyle, mode, contenu pour les réseaux sociaux

🎥 Vidéos courtes, mises en situation et contenus promotionnels

📍 Les shootings seront réalisés dans notre studio à Villefranche-sur-Saône (69).

📩 Intéressé(e) ? Envoyez-nous un message privé avec quelques photos de vous, votre âge et vos disponibilités.

⚠️ Les contenus réalisés pourront être utilisés pour la communication et la promotion du studio, avec votre accord.

🎬 ADULT SCREEN ACTING CLASSES – MANCHESTER 🎬

Want to improve your acting for camera, build your confidence, and get more experience working on screen?

Scene 2 Screen Adult Screen Acting Classes are held every Monday & Tuesday, 7pm–9pm in Manchester and are open to ALL LEVELS — whether you're completely new to acting or already have experience.

🎥 What we cover:�
• Acting for camera�
• Script analysis�
• Self-tape techniques�
• Building confidence on screen
• Industry insight & advice�
• Working with professional scripts

We also regularly bring in industry professionals, including casting directors and directors, for specialist workshops, plus regular agent panels giving you the opportunity to gain valuable insight into the industry.

⭐ BUT HERE'S WHAT REALLY SETS US APART…
Twice during every 4-week block, we film showreel-quality scenes with our students.
You don't just do the scene and forget about it — you get the finished footage to keep and use for your showreel, social media, casting profiles and personal promotion. 🎥

And all of this for just £85 for a 4-week block.

Whether you're looking to get into acting, return to it, sharpen your skills or simply have a go at something new, you'll find a friendly, inclusive and welcoming environment at Scene 2 Screen.

🎬 Monday & Tuesday | 7pm–9pm�📍 Manchester�🎭 All levels welcome�💷 £85 for 4 weeks

📩 Email: Sceen2screenMCR@Gmail.com

🎭 NOT ALL ACTING TRAINING WILL GET YOU CLOSER TO BOOKING WORK.
And you might not even realise it.

If you’ve been taking acting classes for months or even years, but you’re still struggling with your confidence, technique or ability to apply what you’re learning…

Your teacher might not be the right teacher for you.

⚠️ Here are 3 BIG red flags I’d pay VERY close attention to:

1. You’re performing scenes and receiving criticism, but you’re not being TRAINED to improve.

A teacher can critique your scene every week, but if they aren’t giving you the exercises and techniques to develop your overall ability as an actor, that’s criticism, not training.

2. You’re not seeing meaningful growth in your acting, which is holding you back from becoming the extraordinary actor you’re capable of becoming with the right training.

🚨 3. Your acting teacher has never built a successful working career as an actor: How can you be confident that what you’re being taught will help you BOOK WORK if your teacher has never built a successful career themselves?

These are the kinds of red flags that can make you waste months (and thousands of dollars) on training that isn’t moving you forward.

So I created the FREE Acting Teacher Blueprint.

Inside, I’ll show you exactly what kind of training will help you BOOK WORK, so you don’t waste another dollar or another year on acting training that isn’t advancing you.

👇 Comment TEACHER below and DM me TEACHER.

I’ll send you the Blueprint FREE.

AURELLE MODEL MANAGEMENT
International New Face Casting

AURELLE Model Management is currently scouting distinctive female talent aged 18–28 for potential representation and future opportunities within the international fashion industry.

We are looking for individuals with strong presence, individuality and the confidence to bring something unique to the fashion world. We welcome applications from diverse ethnicities, cultures, body types, heights, skin tones, hair textures, facial structures and personal styles.

At AURELLE, difference is not a disadvantage. Your individuality, authenticity and personal identity are what make you memorable.

If you are interested in being considered, please send an email to:

[aurellemodel@gmail.com](mailto:aurellemodel@gmail.com)

Please include:
* Full name
* Age
* Current city and country
* Contact number
* Instagram or social-media profile
* Height
* A brief introduction about yourself
* Recent natural photographs or digitals, including a clear portrait and full-length image

Please ensure that all information submitted is accurate and that photographs are recent, clear and free from heavy filters.

Please arrange to be available for an online callback audition ONLY IF you are selected and notified via email.

All models under the age of 21 must be accompanied during the audition by a parent or legal guardian.

Submitting an application does not guarantee selection or representation. Only selected applicants will be contacted via email.

AURELLE MODEL MANAGEMENT
London | International Talent Scouting

Different is the standard.

**CASTING CALL**

Hi everyone, we’re currently casting for our upcoming comedy short film ‘Never mind’, here are the characters we’re looking for:

Kathy - Playing age 16. A very excitable and imaginative teenager, there will be multiple scenes of scenarios that she makes up in her head, ideally looking for talent who has a good emotional range.

Tony - Playing age 16. The audience only sees the version of Tony that Kathy makes up in her head: an extremely romantic and kind gentleman, until her imagination gets out of control. Seeking an actor with good emotional range.

Laura - playing age 16. Kathy’s best friend; she convinces her to ask out her crush and makes an appearance in Kathy’s made-up scenarios.

Logline: Kathy, a wildly imaginative teenage girl, encounters a sudden change of heart after deciding to ask out her crush. 

We will only be considering actors who are out of license (16+ and completed their GCSEs). It will be a 3 day shoot in late October in Berkshire/London, local talent is highly encouraged to apply.

This is an expenses only opportunity, but travel costs will be covered and food and IMDB credits will be provided.

Some of our past work can be found on our Instagram: @mrmoralsproductions

To apply please email: missalisadali@gmail.com

🎬 **PAID CASTING CALL – ASIAN MALE ACTOR, 18–30**

RAW TV is casting for a **documentary series **and we’re looking for an **Asian male actor aged 18–30** for a paid, non-speaking role.

📍 **Location:** Near Norwich
📅 **Filming:** 30 September–2 October

🚗 **Travel covered, plus accommodation if needed**

This is a non-speaking role, but we’re looking for someone who is comfortable on camera and good at natural reactions and performance.

If interested, please send a **short 30-second introduction video** telling us your name, age and a little about any acting or performance experience. Nothing polished needed, we just want to get a sense of you and your personality.

📩 Send to: **[lisa.gomer@raw.co.uk](mailto:lisa.gomer@raw.co.uk)**

Please feel free to **share or tag anyone who might be suitable**. Thank you!

sharedPost.text:
Bandprobe 
zur VOCALNIGHT,
am 24.09.2026,
 in der Endstation in Buchschlag!

Gestern Abend war es soweit - 
erste und einzige Bandprobe für meine Schülerinnen.

Band: 3 Gitarristen und Drummer 

Ziel war es, sich musikalisch aufeinander einzulassen, einen gemeinsamen Weg zu erarbeiten, um sich beim Auftritt,  in der kommenden Woche, wohl und gut zu fühlen, so dass die Emotionen frei fließen können.

Let‘s play the Music !

After our summer break Chromolume Theatre is back with the breakdown for our final show of our 2026 Season of Identity and Expression, the first fully staged production of the Sondheim/Weidman musical Road Show, directed by Joanna Syiek with musical direction by Richard Berent!  (Note: this is very much an ensemble show, with strong singer/actor/performers needed.)

As always, please submit ALL ETHNICITIES FOR ALL ROLES!

Synopsis: Road Show is a tale of dreamers, based on the true story of the Mizner Brothers, who scramble for success, identity and love at the turn of the twentieth century.

Director: Joanna Syiek

Musical Director: Richard Berent

Audition Date(s): 09/26/2026, 09/27/2026

Callback Date(s): 09/30/2026

Rehearsal Date(s): 10/05/2026, 10/12/2026 to 11/18/2026

Preview Date(s): 11/19/2026

Opening Date(s): 11/20/2026

Closing Date(s): 12/06/2026

Location: The Zephyr Theatre

Rate: $400 honorarium, $300 for Understudies

SUBMIT ELECTRONICALLY: Email headshot & resume to casting@chrtheatre.com, NO VIDEO SUBMISSIONS

SPECIAL NOTE: Auditions are by invitation only and not all submissions will be brought in for an audition. You will be asked to please prepare a 16-32 bar selection of song in the style of the show.  NO WEBBER. An Accompanist will be provided. Bring sheet music in the correct key and cut to length ideally showing the range of the character for which you are auditioning.  Non-AEA

THERE WILL BE UNDERSTUDIES CAST FOR THE ROLES OF WILSON, AND ADDISON, RESPECTIVELY WITH TWO GUARANTEED PERFORMANCES.

Addison: Male Presenting, 30-50. The levelheaded brother living in the shadows of Wilson's schemes. A visionary artist with flair and guile. Cares for his mother. Not as prone to seizing the world as his brother. Easily influenced by his older brother.  Vocal Range: G5-F3.

Wilson: Male Presenting, 30-50. Handsome and charming. Always has a good time, but also lowlife con artist involved in a series of scams. Lives his life as one big, adventurous attempt to seize opportunity. The greedy, selfish brother to Addison.  Vocal Range: A5-F3.

Hollis Bessemer: Male Presenting, 25-30. An honest businessman who rejects the family business to build his dream of an artist colony. Partners with Addison to create an extremely successful real estate business and finally a fortune of his own. Sensitive. Loves Addison. Vocal Range: G5-B3.

Mama: Female Presenting, 50-65. Mother to Addison and Wilson. Encourages her sons to follow opportunity by any means necessary. Coddles Wilson, whom she clearly favors, and ultimately loses him to his own greed. Depends on Addison to take care of her. Vocal Range: E5-G3.

Papa: Male Presenting, 55-75. Father to Addison and Wilson. On his deathbed, he tells his sons to embrace the opportunities of the new world. Proud. Nostalgic.  Vocal Range: E5-A3.

Ensemble: Male and female Presenting, 20s – 50s. All types and singing ranges. Need fantastic singing voices and dynamic personalities to play various roles in the ensemble.

[https://chrtheatre.com/auditions](https://chrtheatre.com/auditions?fbclid=IwcGRvZgVleHRuA2FlbQIxMABicmlkETFqc2FFUE1tbVg5d3RxZFN0c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHo_sJEci2agp51x9Im1hpdYeZ20RKFfoJ_WChpIwJtaMGcmMdglgfEu96t3Y_aem_XRkbEP9vyBpxJooNnLHXdA)

Papa: Male Presenting, 55-75. Father to Addison and Wilson. On his deathbed, he tells his sons to embrace the opportunities of the new world. Proud. Nostalgic.  Vocal Range: E5-A3.

Ensemble: Male and female Presenting, 20s – 50s. All types and singing ranges. Need fantastic singing voices and dynamic personalities to play various roles in the ensemble.

Shoot Duration: Approx. 10 hours.

Compensation: Paid (Competitive rate, details will be shared upon application).

Looking forward to hearing from you!

items.text:
🎙️ POSZUKIWANI AKTORZY GŁOSOWI DO FILMU ANIMOWANEGO 🎬

[ Warszawa / graffiti / hip-hop / animacja 3D ]

👉 PROJEKT PASJONACKI (NON-PROFIT) 👈

Tworzę 15-minutowy niezależny film animowany osadzony w undergroundowym świecie warszawskiego graffiti. To historia o grupie grafficiarzy, zaufaniu i uprzedzeniach.

🔥 CO WYRÓŻNIA TEN PROJEKT?

To nie jest kolejna fikcyjna opowieść zza biurka. Film powstaje w ścisłej współpracy ze środowiskiem:

✓ W projekcie biorą udział znani polscy grafficiarze, którzy oficjalnie przekazali swoje prawdziwe prace do odwzorowania w świecie 3D.

✓ Warstwę muzyczną stworzą producenci i DJ-e mocno związani ze sceną hip-hopową.

✓ Mamy już gotowy scenariusz, storyboardy, blockouty 3D i animatic (którego fragment widzisz w tym poście!).

👇 ZOBACZ NASZ ANIMATIK (2:30 min) WGRANY BEZPOŚREDNIO DO POSTA! 👇

👤 KOGO SZUKAMY? (4 ROLE GŁOSOWE)

Nie musisz być profesjonalistą. Szukamy ludzi z charakterem i naturalnością.

1️⃣ MROZ (mężczyzna, 25 lat) – spokojny, ostrożny, pewny siebie. Od początku wchodzi w mocny konflikt z Husarem, dlatego ta rola może stanowić spore wyzwanie. 

🌟 WAŻNE: Do tej roli szukamy osoby z naturalnym ukraińskim lub białoruskim akcentem!

2️⃣ HUSAR (mężczyzna,  21 lat) – twardy, emocjonalny, bezpośredni. Rola tej postaci na pewno jest wyzywaniem ze względu na mocny konflik z Mrozem na tle rasowym. 

🎥 ZAKRES WSPÓŁPRACY (Głos + Referencje wideo)

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

1. Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

2. Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

Nagrania potrwają od jednego do dwóch dni. 

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ? (ZGŁOSZENIA DO 01.10)

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

🎙️ krótkie nagranie głosowe z wybranymi kwestiami castingowymi

(próbkę tekstu z materiałem do nagrania znajdziesz w dokumencie w pierwszym komentarzu pod postem)

📁 portfolio / wcześniejsze nagrania — jeśli je posiadasz

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

👇 LINK DO DOKUMENTU Z TEKSTAMI I SZCZEGÓŁAMI! 👇

🎙️ POSZUKIWANI AKTORZY GŁOSOWI DO FILMU ANIMOWANEGO 🎬

[ Warszawa / graffiti / hip-hop / animacja 3D ]

👉 PROJEKT PASJONACKI (NON-PROFIT) 👈

Tworzę 15-minutowy niezależny film animowany osadzony w undergroundowym świecie warszawskiego graffiti. To historia o grupie grafficiarzy, zaufaniu i uprzedzeniach.

🔥 CO WYRÓŻNIA TEN PROJEKT?

To nie jest kolejna fikcyjna opowieść zza biurka. Film powstaje w ścisłej współpracy ze środowiskiem:

✓ W projekcie biorą udział znani polscy grafficiarze, którzy oficjalnie przekazali swoje prawdziwe prace do odwzorowania w świecie 3D.

✓ Warstwę muzyczną stworzą producenci i DJ-e mocno związani ze sceną hip-hopową.

✓ Mamy już gotowy scenariusz, storyboardy, blockouty 3D i animatic (którego fragment widzisz w tym poście!).

👇 ZOBACZ NASZ ANIMATIK (2:30 min) WGRANY BEZPOŚREDNIO DO POSTA! 👇

👤 KOGO SZUKAMY? (4 ROLE GŁOSOWE)

Nie musisz być profesjonalistą. Szukamy ludzi z charakterem i naturalnością.

1️⃣ MROZ (mężczyzna, 25 lat) – spokojny, ostrożny, pewny siebie. Od początku wchodzi w mocny konflikt z Husarem, dlatego ta rola może stanowić spore wyzwanie. 

🌟 WAŻNE: Do tej roli szukamy osoby z naturalnym ukraińskim lub białoruskim akcentem!

2️⃣ HUSAR (mężczyzna,  21 lat) – twardy, emocjonalny, bezpośredni. Rola tej postaci na pewno jest wyzywaniem ze względu na mocny konflik z Mrozem na tle rasowym. 

🎥 ZAKRES WSPÓŁPRACY (Głos + Referencje wideo)

Szukamy osób z Warszawy lub okolic (lub gotowych na dojazd), ponieważ współpraca obejmuje dwa etapy:

1. Nagrania dubbingowe w studio.

2. Krótką sesję nagrań wideo (tzw. video reference) – nagramy Twoją grę aktorską i mimikę na kamerze, aby nasi animatorzy mieli idealną bazę do ożywienia postaci w 3D.

Nagrania potrwają od jednego do dwóch dni. 

💰 WARUNKI WSPÓŁPRACY

Projekt jest niezależny i tworzony w 100% z zajawki, dlatego współpraca ma charakter NIEODPŁATNY. Oferujemy pełny credit w napisach końcowych oraz unikalne materiały do aktorskiego demo. Szukamy pasjonatów, którzy chcą mieć realny, twórczy wkład w powstawanie bezkompromisowego i autentycznego filmu.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ? (ZGŁOSZENIA DO 01.10)

W zgłoszeniu możesz przesłać:

🎙️ krótkie nagranie głosowe z wybranymi kwestiami castingowymi

(próbkę tekstu z materiałem do nagrania znajdziesz w dokumencie w pierwszym komentarzu pod postem)

📁 portfolio / wcześniejsze nagrania — jeśli je posiadasz

📱 Instagram / inne social media — opcjonalnie

Nie potrzebujesz profesjonalnego sprzętu – nagranie próbki z telefonu w cichym pokoju w zupełności wystarczy!

Wszystko wyślij na:

📧 EMAIL: m.krzewskigrafika@gmail.com (lub napisz w wiadomości prywatnej).

👇 LINK DO DOKUMENTU Z TEKSTAMI I SZCZEGÓŁAMI! 👇 

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1BIJgru47_mymjk5LL49I-qX80mRdcU3D_BOEfu7MWLc/edit?usp=sharing

items.text:
**Most actors think about the director.**
**Some think about the casting director.**
**Very few think about the editor.**

They should.

**Everything Speaks.**

The audience never sees what happened on the set.

They see **what survives the edit.**

That means your job continues even when you're not speaking.

You're listening.
Processing.
Judging.
Deciding.
Anticipating.

**The editor cannot cut to a dead face.**

A reaction.
A breath.
A decision.
A moment of thought.

A living pause is editorial gold.

Give the editor something to work with.

**Be Editor-Friendly.**

What do actors think about when they are preparing, in order to be **“Editor-Friendly”**?

topComments.text: no one thinks about the sound guy, spending hours doing the sound, his hard work listening for error or something strange, his passion for unique moments captured

items.text:
@Michael Clarke Duncan  — the big guy with the softest heart in Hollywood.
 6'5", 300+ lbs, deep voice, but made you cry as John Coffey.
- *Breakout role*: _The Green Mile_ (1999) as *John Coffey* — innocent death row inmate with healing powers. Got an Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actor. That line: _"I'm tired, boss."_
- *Other big films*:
    - _Armageddon_ as Bear
    - _The Whole Nine Yards_
    - _Daredevil_ (2003) as Kingpin / Wilson Fisk — first major on-screen Kingpin
    - _Sin City_, _Talladega Nights_, _Kung Fu Panda_ — voice of Commander Vachir
    - _The Island, Planet of the Apes (2001)_
- *Before acting*: From Chicago. Dug ditches for a gas company, worked as a bouncer, and was a bodyguard for stars like Will Smith and Jamie Foxx. Didn't start acting full-time until his 30s
- *Style*: Gentle giant type — could be terrifying and then make you cry in the same scene
- *Life*: Died September 3, 2012 at age 54 after a heart attack. His fiancée at the time was Omarosa Manigault

He was one of those actors everyone on set loved — Bruce Willis called him family after _Armageddon_ and helped get him the _Green Mile_ audition.

@Michael Clarke Duncan  — the big guy with the softest heart in Hollywood.
 6'5", 300+ lbs, deep voice, but made you cry as John Coffey.
- *Breakout role*: _The Green Mile_ (1999) as *John Coffey* — innocent death row inmate with healing powers. Got an Oscar nomination for Best Supporting Actor. That line: _"I'm tired, boss."_
- *Other big films*:
    - _Armageddon_ as Bear
    - _The Whole Nine Yards_
    - _Daredevil_ (2003) as Kingpin / Wilson Fisk — first major on-screen Kingpin
    - _Sin City_, _Talladega Nights_, _Kung Fu Panda_ — voice of Commander Vachir
    - _The Island, Planet of the Apes (2001)_
- *Before acting*: From Chicago. Dug ditches for a gas company, worked as a bouncer, and was a bodyguard for stars like Will Smith and Jamie Foxx. Didn't start acting full-time until his 30s
- *Style*: Gentle giant type — could be terrifying and then make you cry in the same scene
- *Life*: Died September 3, 2012 at age 54 after a heart attack. His fiancée at the time was Omarosa Manigault

He was one of those actors everyone on set loved — Bruce Willis called him family after _Armageddon_ and helped get him the _Green Mile_ audition.

#actor #actress #film #movies #talent

💢CASTING CALL 💢
Its that time again....

Auditions (self tapes) are now open for 'Benji jnr' and "Benji's mum". 

The cycle is a short film based around a young man struggling to break the cycle of generational and childhood trauma and the challenges he faces. 

The film is the second film of Tori Hughes, who's first film 'The Aftermath' is an award winning film and currently doing the festival circuit. 

See slides for roles, dates and details.

Please be aware that roles are currently expenses only however fundraising is ongoing and so this may change given budget. Film will be entered into the festival circuit and is built to raise awareness of themes involved. 

Please message myself, Claire Ward   or Sarah Elizabeth if you wish to self tape. We look forward to watching!

Deadline is 20th September.
